title: Endorsement
description: Endorsement ACDC used by the joint-issuance threshold operators (MxN, RMxN, MxQ, RMxQ). Its issuer (i) records a disposition (disp) toward the subject identified by 'said' for the act named in 'act'. An endorsement is authenticated by anchoring: the endorser seals this ACDC's SAID in an event of its own KEL, directly or by way of a TEL that KEL anchors. It is not signed and carries no attached signature. An anchored instance with disp 'endorse' is an authenticated endorsement that counts toward a threshold; an anchored instance with disp 'decline' is an authenticated declination that records attributable dissent and never counts. An unanchored instance is only a placeholder reserving a slot for a named candidate; its field values are not authoritative until anchored. For the qualified operators (MxQ, RMxQ) the endorser additionally supplies a qualification-proof edge (e.qp), and the operator's 'qs' field names the schema that proof must satisfy; for the unqualified operators (MxN, RMxN) the edges block is omitted.

i.description: AID of the endorser. In an unanchored placeholder it names the candidate from whom a disposition is expected; in an anchored instance it is the authenticated endorser.

s.description: SAID of the schema applied to this ACDC.

a.description: Attributes block. Compact form: SAID string. Expanded form: object naming the endorsed subject, the act, and the disposition.

said.description: SAID of the subject being endorsed, typically the dossier ACDC whose joint issuance this endorsement contributes to.

act.description: The act addressed. 'issue' pertains to an MxN or MxQ issuance threshold; 'revoke' pertains to an RMxN or RMxQ revocation threshold. Binding the act prevents a disposition toward issuance from being replayed as one toward revocation, or vice versa.

disp.description: The endorser's disposition. 'endorse' is an approval that, when anchored, counts toward the operator's threshold. 'decline' is an authenticated refusal that records attributable dissent and never counts.

reason.description: Optional human-readable explanation, most useful with disp 'decline'.

e.description: Optional edges block. Present for qualified dispositions (MxQ, RMxQ) to carry the qualification-proof edge; omitted for unqualified dispositions (MxN, RMxN). Compact form: SAID string. Expanded form: object with a qp edge.

qp.description: Qualification-proof edge. References an ACDC that proves the endorser is qualified to act on the subject. The referenced ACDC MUST validate against the schema named in the operator's 'qs' field.

s.description: SAID of the schema the qualification-proof ACDC MUST validate against; matches the operator's 'qs'.
